items.body: One pantograph, from the backing. Good for charity tops, baby quilts, and anything that should read as texture.

items.title: Custom

items.title: Basting
items.body: For hand quilters who want the sandwich pinned on the frame.

sections.heading: Send the quilt size and a photo of the top

sections.title: Services and pricing
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Square-inch rates, thread, batting, and what I need from you before the top arrives.

items.title: Edge-to-edge
items.body: Pantograph or digitized overall. Density is light, medium, or heavy. You pick from the binder or send a file.

items.title: Custom
items.body: Drawn in the hoop of the quilt. Borders, blocks, and sashing can each have their own design.

items.title: Batting and backing
items.body: Hobbs 80/20 and wool on the shelf. Backing should be 8 inches larger than the top on all sides.

items.title: Rush
items.body: If the frame is open, a two-week slot can move to one. Rush is a flat fee, not a higher rate.

sections.heading: How to prepare a top
sections.html: Press seams. Stay-stitch the edges if they wobble. Clip threads on the back. Do not pin or baste. Fold, do not hang, for the drive over. If the backing is pieced, press that seam open.

sections.title: About {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: One Gammill on a 12-foot frame, in a garage studio on the north side of {{city}}.

sections.html:
I quilted on a domestic machine for a decade before I bought the longarm. Most of the work is still edge-to-edge for guild charity tops and shop samples. Custom slots are booked six to eight weeks out.

Studio visits are by appointment. The dog stays in the house.

sections.heading: Hours
sections.note: Drop-offs are Tuesday and Thursday. Pickups are Friday.

sections.title: Request a quote
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Width, length, edge-to-edge or custom, and a photo of the top. I reply within two business days.

items.q: Do I need to send the quilt first?
items.a: No. A photograph and the measurements are enough for a quote. Bring the quilt when you accept the date.
Yes. Shop samples are billed at the edge-to-edge rate with a net-30 invoice.

sections.title: Questions
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Loading, thread, batting, and what happens if a seam opens on the frame.

items.a: Glide for most edge-to-edge. Cotton for custom when the top is cotton. I will not use metallic in the needle without a written note from you.

items.q: Can you quilt a T-shirt quilt?
items.a: Yes, at the custom rate, because the blocks shift. Stabilize them before you bring the top.
I stop, call, and wait. I do not restitch a seam unless you ask me to in writing.
Machine binding is $0.18 a linear inch. Hand binding is not offered.
